curatedMovie.curiosityHook: A past double murder seemingly tore the family next door apart, but the surviving son's quiet presence suggests the horror never truly ended.
curatedMovie.description: After moving to a new town, a mother and daughter discover their next-door neighbor's home was the site of a brutal double murder. When the daughter befriends the surviving son, a dark history begins to resurface.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, heavy suburban dread with medium pacing that commands engaged, solitary attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Mark Tonderai delivers a steady, suspenseful horror-thriller anchored in suburban unease, balancing a heavy family tragedy with tightening psychological dread.

facts.title: House at the End of the Street
